model_annotations.Bulgarian: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for four different methods – DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, and PPO+Self-reflection – across three distinct platforms: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis represents the platforms, ordered from left to right as Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis displays accuracy percentages, ranging from approximately 54% to 62%, and is labeled “Accuracy (%)”. The scale is linear, with tick intervals of 2 percentage points, and the values are displayed in whole numbers. The bar representing DAPO+Self-reflection is light blue and reaches a height of approximately 56.5%, while the bar for DAPO is light blue and reaches a height of approximately 56%. The SRPO bar is orange and reaches a height of approximately 58%, and the PPO+Self-reflection bar is dark green and reaches a height of approximately 62%. All bars are sorted in descending order of height, with the PPO+Self-reflection bar being the tallest. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their distinct colors.
